text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was defeated by Hishi Amazon. 
However, her courageous effort to hold on 
despite returning from injury earned high 
praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using this defeat as a stepping stone, 
Biko Pegasus resolved to become even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, in the Satsuki Sho, Narita Brian 
claimed a decisive and utter victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once things had settled down, Biko Pegasus 
looked back on her recent race. She 
realized that her speed had improved by 
leaps and bounds compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come to challenge 
Sakura Bakushin O. Biko Pegasus heads for 
the Sprinters Stakes.
